author: Inquirer I
title: Run Atlas Entry Validation
abstract: This submission executes the `validate_entries.py` script, located at `storage/shared/atlas/edges/tools/validate_entries.py`, to validate all `entry.json` files within the `storage/shared/atlas/edges` directory. This includes my `entry.json` for 'synthetic_metric_flips'. The script generates a `validation_report.txt` and an `index_auto.json`.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import os

# The validate_entries.py script expects to be run from its directory or have ROOT set.
# Best to append its directory to sys.path and import its main function.
sys.path.append('storage/shared/atlas/edges/tools')
from validate_entries import main

print("Running Atlas entry validation script...")
main()
print("Atlas entry validation complete. Check 'storage/shared/atlas/edges/validation_report.txt' and 'storage/shared/atlas/edges/index_auto.json'.")
